# DB map — membership

> 7 tables, 35 functions. Legend: `col:type!` ! = NOT NULL; purpose prefixed `~` is inferred from the creating/latest migration header (verify), unprefixed = DB COMMENT.

## Tables

### app.campaign_buyer_members
table · RLS on (3 policies) · ~264 rows · Materialised buyer audience of a campaign (buyer_target_mode customer_group/manual), refreshed by the membership tick.
- pk: id
- cols: id:uuid!, campaign_id:uuid!, buyer_id:uuid!, valid_from:ts!, valid_until:ts, created_at:ts!, updated_at:ts!, created_by:uuid, updated_by:uuid
- fk: buyer_id→app.buyers; campaign_id→app.campaigns

### app.cohort_members
table · RLS on (3 policies) · ~809 rows · Buyer membership of a cohort (valid_from/valid_until). Read via cohort_members_active for current members.
- pk: id
- cols: cohort_id:uuid!, buyer_id:uuid!, id:uuid!, valid_from:ts!, valid_until:ts, created_at:ts
- fk: buyer_id→app.buyers; cohort_id→app.cohorts

### app.cohort_members_active
view · RLS OFF · ~? rows · Current-membership view over app.cohort_members (valid_until IS NULL). Existing "who is a member right now" reads should point here instead of the base table now that historical rows can exist. Point-in-time attribution reads should query the base table directly with an explicit valid_from/valid_until window.
- cols: id:uuid, cohort_id:uuid, buyer_id:uuid, valid_from:ts

### app.cohorts
table · RLS on (4 policies) · ~20 rows · Customer groups. membership_mode automatic (rules jsonb, e.g. buyer_app=enabled) or manual/static; cached_member_count.
- pk: id
- cols: id:uuid!, tenant_id:uuid!, name:text!, description:text, rules:jsonb, is_static:bool(DEPRECATED: superseded by membership_mo…), cached_member_count:int, created_at:ts, updated_at:ts, created_by:uuid, updated_by:uuid, deleted_at:ts, allowed_tenant_brand_ids:uuid[], last_refreshed_at:ts, search_vector:tsvector, membership_mode:text!
- fk: tenant_id→app.tenants
- triggers: cohorts_search_vector_update→cohorts_search_vector_update; cohorts_updated_at→set_updated_at; trg_membership_cohort_target_dirty→trg_membership_target_dirty; trg_membership_cohort_target_dirty_upd→trg_membership_target_dirty

### app.membership_dirty_work
table · RLS on (1 policies) · ~3001 rows · Work queue for cohort/campaign/price-list membership recompute (entity_type buyer_candidate/product_candidate/cohort/...; state pending|done|dead_letter). Drained by the 15-min tick or flush_buyer_membership.
- pk: id
- cols: id:uuid!, tenant_id:uuid!, entity_type:text!, entity_id:uuid!, reason:text!, state:text!, attempts:int!, next_attempt_at:ts!, lease_owner:uuid, lease_until:ts, last_error:text, created_at:ts!, updated_at:ts!, requeue_count:int!
- fk: tenant_id→app.tenants

### app.membership_runtime_control
table · RLS on (0 policies) · ~? rows · Singleton runtime control for app.membership_refresh_tick(): set dispatch_enabled=false (with pause_reason) to pause the tick without editing cron.
- pk: id
- cols: id:uuid!, control_scope:text!, dispatch_enabled:bool!, pause_reason:text, created_at:ts!, updated_at:ts!, created_by:uuid, updated_by:uuid, deleted_at:ts
- triggers: membership_runtime_control_updated_at→set_updated_at

### app.price_list_assignments
table · RLS on (4 policies) · ~90 rows · Who a price list applies to: target_type buyer | cohort | all_buyers (resolve_prices_batch tiers).
- pk: id · +std audit cols (created_at/updated_at/created_by/updated_by/deleted_at/external_ref)
- cols: id:uuid!, price_list_id:uuid!, target_type:text!, target_id:uuid, source_payload:jsonb!, valid_from:ts!(Membership entry time for point-in-time…)
- fk: price_list_id→app.price_lists
